03707 ka`ac {kaw-as'}

字根型; TWOT - 1016; 動詞

欽定本 - anger 43, provoked 3, angry 2, grieved 1, indignation 1,
     sorrow 1, vex 1, wrath 1, wroth 1; 54

1) 苦惱, 生氣
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) 苦惱, 憤恨
       1a2) 生氣
   1b) (Piel) 挑起怒氣
   1c) (Hiphil)
       1c1) 苦惱
       1c2) 苦惱, 惹動怒氣,特別是因敬拜別神惹動耶和華的怒氣
record.edic_text:
03707 ka`ac {kaw-as'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 1016; v

AV - anger 43, provoked 3, angry 2, grieved 1, indignation 1,
     sorrow 1, vex 1, wrath 1, wroth 1; 54

1) to be angry, be vexed, be indignant, be wroth, be grieved, provoke
   to anger and wrath
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) to be vexed, be indignant
       1a2) to be angry
   1b) (Piel) to provoke to anger
   1c) (Hiphil)
       1c1) to vex
       1c2) to vex, provoke to anger
